ask: Do you have anything... alive? A pet, maybe.
pitch: ::His smile widens and he pulls a thin, slightly stained catalog from under the desk.:: You're in luck! Our brand new Companionship line. House cats, bred right here in Core City: clean, quiet, and they keep the vermin out. Two hundred charons. Or, for the security-minded resident, a dog: loyal, alert, hardcore. Three hundred fifty. Both delivered straight to your living room, food bowl included.
buyCat: I'll take a cat. ::Pay {0} stygian coins.::
buyDog: I'll take a dog. ::Pay {0} stygian coins.::
full: ::He glances at his notes.:: With respect, your living room has all the companionship it can take. Even we have standards.
bought: Excellent choice! It'll be waiting for you in your living room. Express delivery! ::He scribbles a note in the margin of the catalog.:: It doesn't have a name yet; we leave that honour to the owner.
catHello: ::{0} watches you from across the room, blinks slowly, and goes back to washing a paw.::
dogHello: ::{0} trots over, tail going so hard that the whole back half of it wags along.::
newCatHello: ::A cat, still a little wary of its new home, sniffs at your boots. The delivery tag on its collar has a blank line for a name.::
newDogHello: ::A dog sits at your feet and looks up at you, waiting. The delivery tag on its collar has a blank line for a name.::
catPetted: ::It tolerates exactly three strokes, then purrs anyway.::
dogPetted: ::It leans its whole weight into your hand and sighs happily.::
name: ::Give it a name.::
comeAlong: Come on, you're coming with me.
feedMeat: ::Give it a piece of raw Cave Hopper Meat.::
catFed: ::The cat sniffs the raw meat, considers it for a long moment, then drags it under the sofa.::
dogFed: ::The dog swallows it whole, then looks at your hands for more.::
catFedSteak: ::The cat eats the steak with great dignity and then purrs loud enough to rattle the furniture.::
dogFedSteak: ::The dog wolfs down the steak and runs two happy laps around you.::
